description: Item B (B.1a-rev.4) — full LP-dual extraction for a_K. Solves the operator-selection LP per `prop:mass-coefficient-shadow-price` for each of proton/neutron/D/T/³He/⁴He at f64 precision (scipy linprog via lp_dual_solver.solve_operator_selection_lp) and extracts literal u_λ^* dual variables. Compares the chirality-active dual sum to closed-form C = (1+h, 1-h², (1-h²)²) at A=2,3,4. Emits witness with all required LP-dual fields per AGENTS.md §LP/SDP duals first-class infra. Note: this is f64-precision verification; MPFR-50dps follow-on would be a future iteration.
caveats: B.1a-rev.4 PROBE-ONLY: the LP basis used here is the Wedderburn-block projector basis {π_λ : λ ⊢ n}, giving a block-DIAGONAL Frobenius Gram G_λλ' = w_λ · δ_λλ'. This is too coarse for the operator-selection LP. Posed over the full partition set under convention D it was DEGENERATE (the vanishing l>=3 blocks are zero-cost free columns, so y0^* = 0); posed on the two-row quotient (2026-10-10, bean qou-e9le) it is non-degenerate but a_K^dual misses the closed-form C by 10x-1.8e4x at every atom — a scope-(a) negative for THIS basis, not for the shadow-price proposition. The full operator-selection LP per `prop:mass-coefficient-shadow-price` requires the full Hecke algebra basis {b_i : i = 1..[n]_q!} with non-diagonal Gram G_ij = tr_M(b_i b_j). That setup is an open R&D item (per Item B audit §7c B.1a-rev.4); the present script wires the SDP-attribution path and surfaces the block-diagonal LP's degeneracy as an empirical finding.
